leaves.title: The actual flow
leaves.lead: Provider → account → player → your screen.
leaves.detail: The provider supplies the stream or remote library. You normally keep no movie files at home. A server invitation, IPTV playlist and commercial streaming subscription use different protocols and account systems; a single app does not automatically merge them.

leaves.title: Five connections are not five customers
leaves.lead: Independent access requires independent upstream identities.
leaves.detail: One shared username with five simultaneous connections remains one identity. Removing a player playlist does not revoke a copied URL. The provider must issue five separate accounts or revocable device tokens, or explicitly authorize a correctly designed gateway. Player activation and content authorization are separate.

leaves.title: The pass/fail test
leaves.lead: Suspend C; A, B, D and E must keep working.
leaves.detail: Test both new and active sessions. Reset C, check its old credential fails, then restore it. Record device allowance, stream limit and expiration separately. Never store live passwords in this HTML file.

leaves.title: Diagnose before changing players
leaves.lead: Compare the same authorized source in two clients.
leaves.detail: Keep device, network and time close. If both fail, investigate upstream service, credentials, concurrency or network. If only Flix fails, investigate its profile, version and codec support. A new paid activation does not repair an upstream outage.

leaves.title: Free-first candidates
leaves.lead: VLC · Kodi · IPTVnator · SS IPTV
leaves.detail: These can play compatible external streams/playlists but are not universal customer provisioning consoles. Their actual platform scope is listed in the report. IPTVnator is primarily desktop/web, not a verified native client for every TV. Free and widely available does not mean a complete managed reseller solution.

leaves.title: Freemium and paid candidates
leaves.lead: Televizo · TiviMate · iMPlayer · Smarters Pro
leaves.detail: Choose by exact device and required features. iMPlayer offers central device configuration on supported platforms; this still cannot revoke shared upstream credentials. Do not assume every free tier includes multi-device management.

leaves.title: Smart-TV activation alternatives
leaves.lead: SmartOne IPTV · IBO Player
leaves.detail: Device activation and playlist control can suit compatible televisions. Check exact store listing, manufacturer, country, trial and price. Similarly named products are not automatically the same vendor.

leaves.title: Different category: remote media servers
leaves.lead: Jellyfin · Plex · Emby
leaves.detail: These serve a host’s file library to matching clients. An invitation is not interchangeable with an M3U playlist or Xtream-style login. The owner controls available users, library, downloads and uptime.

title: 3 · How media arrives
desc: Twenty routes, with files distinguished from access.

leaves.title: Discs and recordings
leaves.lead: DVD · Blu-ray/UHD · antenna tuner · VHS/home video
leaves.detail: Unprotected or authorized sources can become files through a compatible drive or capture/recording system. HandBrake encodes; it does not itself remove DRM. TV recording needs reception, tuner compatibility and storage; encrypted ATSC 3.0 can be a blocker.

leaves.title: Downloadable files
leaves.lead: Archive · Library of Congress · NASA · music stores
leaves.detail: Review each item’s rights and actual download format. Bandcamp and Qobuz download-store purchases can deliver files; purchase of a stream-only subscription is a different product. Preserve creator permissions and original home recordings.

leaves.title: Other file paths
leaves.lead: Camera · screen capture · podcasts · USB · family/cloud delivery
leaves.detail: The report includes equipment, intake flow, approximate costs and practical limitations. Each authorized file goes through verification before metadata and library import. A file license does not transfer the creator’s copyright.

leaves.title: Access without ownership
leaves.lead: Tubi · Netflix · remote server invitation · licensed IPTV
leaves.detail: Provider stream or app-controlled offline cache stays within the service’s rules. No home NAS is needed. Sonarr/Radarr cannot turn a subscription into a collection you own. Vimeo On Demand is not a new-purchase route: new purchases stopped September 21, 2026.

title: 4 · Torrent research & Reddit
desc: Specific sources plus verified integration limits.

leaves.title: The automation chain
leaves.lead: Prowlarr → Sonarr/Radarr → qBittorrent → files
leaves.detail: Prowlarr manages indexers. Sonarr handles TV monitoring/import; Radarr handles movies. qBittorrent transfers. These are different jobs. Download the apps from official project sites, not torrent listings. Start with one clearly authorized sample.

leaves.title: Six sources researched
leaves.lead: Internet Archive · 1337x · Nyaa.si · TorrentLeech · EZTV · YTS
leaves.detail: Archive is a rights-checked direct torrent/manual-import route. Maintained Prowlarr definitions were checked for the other five. Nyaa is specialist; EZTV is TV; YTS is compact movies; TorrentLeech needs legitimate private access. A maintained definition is not an uptime test or copyright license.
leaves.keys: D1 D4 D5 D6 D7 D8

leaves.title: What community threads suggest
leaves.lead: qBittorrent is repeatedly suggested; Usenet opinions differ.
leaves.detail: The reviewed Reddit sample is qualitative, not a census. Some users favor paid Usenet indexers; others say torrents meet their needs. Reported problems include wrong movie matching, domain/challenge failures, hard-link cleanup and seeding obligations. Exact dates are not invented when cached pages show only relative age.

leaves.title: Outdated lists and safe operation
leaves.lead: Do not treat RARBG clones or an unverified TGx continuation as trusted.
leaves.detail: The original RARBG closure is documented historically. TorrentGalaxy had serious 2025 outages; a genuine dependable current continuation was not verified. Avoid executable/codec prompts. Keep administration private. Use qBittorrent’s intended VPN interface and test disconnect behavior.

leaves.title: Usenet or rented compute
leaves.lead: SABnzbd is a different downloader; a remote host can store files.
leaves.detail: Usenet needs an indexer and a provider, not just SABnzbd. Budget figures in the report are allowances. A rented server that you administer can run the stack without a home NAS, subject to its contract. A read-only upstream IPTV or Plex account normally cannot.

leaves.title: Chosen architecture
leaves.lead: AS6810T storage + separate Intel graphics-capable media host
leaves.detail: The ten-HDD-bay AS6810T has built-in 10GbE but no integrated video GPU. Separate compute makes transcoding upgrades independent of storage. The exact disk SKU, host codec support and five-stream workload still require real validation.

leaves.title: Starting disks and protection
leaves.lead: Four equal approved CMR drives, RAID6; keep working space free.
leaves.detail: Four drives permit dual parity from day one. Three drives would mean a different protection choice, such as RAID5. RAID is availability protection, not backup. Add a UPS, health monitoring, configuration backups and protected copies of irreplaceable media.

leaves.title: Capacity arithmetic
leaves.lead: 10 × 26 TB = 260 TB raw → 208 TB after dual parity
leaves.detail: 208 decimal TB is about 189.2 TiB before filesystem overhead. Keeping 20% free leaves about 166.4 TB for comfortable working data. A genuine 200 TB working target needs more capacity. The 26 TB disks are illustrative, not confirmed AS6810T compatibility.

leaves.title: Ten-model comparison
leaves.lead: Only one clearly current exact-ten fit was verified.
leaves.detail: The report ranks AS6810T, TS-1655, DS2422+, DS3622xs+, TVS-AIh1688ATX, TVS-h874, AS6510T, TS-1273AU-RP, TS-1232PXU-RP and DS1825+. Older stock and 8-/12-bay alternatives are labelled; SSD slots are not counted as large HDD bays.

leaves.title: Budget warning
leaves.lead: Example starting package: about $8,003–9,043 before tax.
leaves.detail: This uses listed AS6810T pricing and four unusually expensive example 26 TB disks, plus host/network/UPS/limited backup allowances. It is not a fixed quote or approved shopping cart. No equipment was purchased; verify compatible capacity and value before committing.

title: 6 · Grow without starting over
desc: One catalog does not mean one storage pool.

leaves.title: Add drives inside the first box
leaves.lead: Expansion reshapes/rebalances data; it does not normally erase it.
leaves.detail: Supported expansion depends on the OS, RAID type, healthy starting state and eligible drive sizes. At 100–200 MB/s, one full 26 TB pass is roughly 72–36 hours; actual reshape can take days and reduce performance. Backup first, expand one supported step at a time.

leaves.title: Add a second standalone NAS
leaves.lead: NAS1 + NAS2 → stable SMB/NFS mounts → one server library
leaves.detail: Two separate protected storage pools, one movie/TV catalog. If NAS2 fails, its titles are unavailable, while healthy NAS1 content should remain usable. Protect the central server database and test its handling of an offline mount before cleanup.

leaves.title: Expansion enclosure tradeoff
leaves.lead: A compatible shelf shares the host’s availability and connector limits.
leaves.detail: It is not a standalone NAS. AS6004U uses USB 5Gbps, not 10GbE, and adds independent external storage spaces. Supported AS6810T expansion is up to 22 HDDs total. Synology/QNAP shelves must match the exact host, connector and firmware.

leaves.title: Software unification
leaves.lead: Library aggregation is simplest; mergerfs is optional.
leaves.detail: A unified folder view does not create redundancy, merge performance, or erase separate failure domains. Distributed storage adds significant networking and recovery complexity; two linked boxes are not automatically a resilient cluster.

title: 7 · Network, serving & playback
desc: Local speed, internet speed and decoding are separate.

leaves.title: 10GbE end to end
leaves.lead: NAS port → matching cable/switch → host 10Gb NIC
leaves.detail: Use compatible RJ45/Cat6a, or matched SFP+ NICs and DAC/fiber where appropriate. Budget the card, switch, transceivers and UPS. Link negotiation does not guarantee disks sustain 10Gb. Ethernet link aggregation is not automatically a faster single stream.

leaves.title: Five remote viewers
leaves.lead: Illustrative 1080p: 5 × 8 Mbps = 40 Mbps payload
leaves.detail: Plan around 60 Mbps stable upload for that example. Five 80 Mbps 4K streams need 400 Mbps payload and roughly 550–600 Mbps allowance. Actual source bitrate and seeking bursts vary. A 10Gb LAN never upgrades your internet upload.

leaves.title: Direct play versus conversion
leaves.lead: A compatible client avoids unnecessary video transcoding.
leaves.detail: Direct play sends the original for the device to decode. Transcoding changes the video and may require GPU support. HDR tone mapping and subtitle burn-in can make a workload harder. NAS model names do not establish a universal stream count.

leaves.title: Jellyfin / Plex / Emby
leaves.lead: Free-first Jellyfin; Plex for demonstrated client fit; Emby as an alternative
leaves.detail: Use the exact platform matrix in the report. Jellyfin official components are free. Plex hardware acceleration and remote-viewing rules are distinct. Current Remote Watch Pass: $2.99/month or $29.99/year; administrator Plex Pass can qualify viewers. Emby paid features have household/device terms.

leaves.title: PIA needs careful routing
leaves.lead: Isolate the approved download route, not every service.
leaves.detail: Full-tunnel VPN and kill-switch rules can disrupt LAN shares, discovery and inbound remote playback. PIA is not automatically a private mesh. Test the final routing; do not expose NAS administration to the public internet.

title: 8 · Organization, safety & acceptance
desc: A small working system beats unnecessary automation.

leaves.title: Essential foundation
leaves.lead: Clean folders · correct metadata · independent accounts · backups
leaves.detail: Separate Movies, TV, Music, Home Video and Recordings. Use one naming authority. Server playback should normally have read access; organizers get scoped write access. Restore-test both files and server configuration.

leaves.title: Optional helpers
leaves.lead: Bazarr · Seerr · Tautulli · Kometa · Tdarr · Audiobookshelf
leaves.detail: Subtitles, requests, Plex telemetry, collections, encoding and audio libraries respectively. Add only when a need appears. A provider’s read-only library does not become writable because you install these tools locally.

leaves.title: Before declaring it operational
leaves.lead: Five-user revocation + exact-device playback + five-viewer load
leaves.detail: Also verify 10Gb negotiation, supported expansion, second-NAS failure behavior, VPN disconnect/remote reachability and a real restore. The report includes pass/fail criteria rather than unsupported guarantees.

leaves.title: What is complete today
leaves.lead: Research, written report, offline explorer, printable map and MP3
leaves.detail: This is the finished decision/design package. No hardware, production server or customer accounts were deployed. Live purchase prices, source availability and app-store coverage can change; the source register records evidence and gaps.
